default_rule: A workflow not explicitly listed as CURRENT or CURRENT_COMPATIBLE is not permitted in the live .github/workflows namespace.

cybalicistjt-stack/multiversal-aioc.disposition: All pre-CRS AIOC workflows are HISTORICAL_INERT for the duration of the stop-the-line and are removed from the live Actions namespace. Git history is the preservation mechanism. CRS-06 will introduce a new narrowly scoped registered repository-health gate; any operational/content workflow later restored must be explicitly reclassified and reviewed rather than grandfathered.

trigger_proof.reason_for_full_quarantine: Even general workflows were broad, GitHub-hosted, lifecycle-coupled, or not Validation-Core governed; retaining them by default would preserve the same stale-execution risk CRS exists to remove.

live_workflows.purpose: Shared self-hosted Linux/Windows exact-head validation, diagnostics, deterministic receipts and comparator for future thin profiles.
Manual runner availability/toolchain smoke; it is not a feature completion gate.

classes: DT-001 through DT-010 tranche proof workflows
IA-D09 and Internal Alpha setup/successor proof workflows
Stage-A A1 through A12 proof workflows
VCH-01 through VCH-06 program proof workflows
paused CCTI-12 and post-GATX feature-specific workflows until those branches are reconciled
retired_from_live_namespace.preservation: All removed workflow definitions remain recoverable from Git history at baseline commit 1ff5cf7f966df8fae5840c45d94919dd9aea1925.

cybalicistjt-stack/Multiversal-app.paused_feature_rule: PR #191 and PR #201 remain preserved but cannot merge under their historical workflow plumbing. On CRS completion/resumption they must reconcile with cleaned main and use a thin Validation Core profile or a new documented capability exception before completion.

crs03_acceptance.remaining_gate: Fast-forward both repository cleanup candidates and verify post-merge workflow namespaces before marking CRS-03 completed_verified.
